jobs.title: Member of GTM Staff
jobs.description: **About 8090** The Software Industrial Complex has evolved into a bloated, expensive ecosystem that burdens enterprises with unnecessary complexity and inefficiency. Co\-founded and led by Chamath Palihapitiya, we are building a Software Factory that delivers fully\-managed and hosted software purpose\-built for each customer. **About the role** At 8090\.ai, we're scaling our sales team to capture a two large market opportunities: replacing legacy software, and building custom software \- for both the enterprise and the public sectors. We need Members of GTM Staff to own end\-to\-end complex enterprise deal cycles within one or two of our five commercial verticals: Manufacturing, Life Sciences/Med Devices, Financial Services, Technology Media and Telecom, and Insurance. This is not a role for someone who needs a playbook handed to them; it requires high agency, near\-complete autonomy, and carries substantial revenue generation responsibilities. If successful, you will grow into a Senior Member of GTM Staff role and a path toward leading a vertical at 8090\. We've built a Software Factory that brings control, consistency, and quality to the Software Development Lifecycle (the SDLC). On the 8090 Enterprise team, we use Software Factory to modernize legacy technologies for customers, and to build bespoke software solutions for the Fortune 2000\. We price our modernization and custom software work on a deliverables (modernization) or milestone basis (custom) and our customers tell us this is unique. Our technical teams are world\-class, the tools we have available to us are incredible, and the opportunity to drive meaningful impact for our customers is nearly unlimited. **Location** On\-site Redwood City or Remote\* **Responsibilities** * End\-to\-end deal cycles: prospecting \> discovery \> business case creation \> co\-author lightweight product requirements documents \> scope with sales engineering/CTO \> lead negotiations and execute on contracts \> maintain executive relationships as projects go live. * Building relationships with customer executives and the creation of high\-quality business cases that clearly articulate problems to solve or opportunities to unlock that have asymmetric upside (ROI) for the customer. * Running technical discovery with cross\-functional teams (Technical Product Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and our customer teams) to assess workflows, cost structures, data maturity, and AI readiness. Support for the product requirement document (PRD) development or legacy system assessment processes that enable us to scope and size deals. * Execution of complex, seven\-figure TCV deals, done in half the time of traditional enterprise sales cycles. * Multi\-threaded executive engagement across CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, CDO, Operations, IT, Transformation, and Finance. * The development of tools (agents, functioning software) that complement our sales chip (we aspire to run 8090 like a computer) and enable us to run the business at seemingly impossible per\-employee efficiency levels. * Evangelize 8090 through executive workshops, industry events, and analyst engagement. **Required Skills** * A founder\-like mindset: high bias for action, persistence, grit, and comfort with ambiguity. You are high\-agency: you find the path, you don’t wait for one. * 5\-10 years of enterprise sales experience selling large\-scale SaaS, data, or AI transformation programs. You do not need to have led teams; you need to have carried a number and beaten it. * A track record of punching above your weight: you’ve built trusted relationships with executives well senior to your title (CIOs, CFOs, COOs) and they’ll act as references to that effect. * A track record of closing seven\-figure TCV deals with complex, multi\-stakeholder buying processes involving C\-suite, Finance, Legal, and InfoSec. * Genuine curiosity about one or two of our verticals: you’ve sold into them, or you’re hungry to earn the secrets of how those customers run their businesses and how they buy. * Strong commercial and deal\-craft instincts: pricing conversations, negotiation, and creative deal structures don’t scare you. * Working fluency in AI/LLM concepts and the SDLC. You are a full\-stack sales person and want to build.Eager to roll up your sleeves, get involved in the details, work hard, and build something great **Expected compensation (US\-based employees):** $175K\-$250K annual salary \+ stock and/or stock option awards \+ benefits \+ commission. We offer competitive pay and benefits. Compensation may vary depending on many individualized factors, including location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Details of the compensation package, including benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401K, …), will be provided if and when a candidate receives an offer of employment. **Employment Eligibility\-** This position is only open to candidates who can provide sufficient documentation establishing employment eligibility in the United States of America and to **provide satisfactory proof of your identity as required by U.S. law**. A further condition of your employment is satisfactory completion of a credit and/or criminal background check. **We do not provide new work visa sponsorship.** **Equal Opportunity Statement \-** 8090 is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Member of GTM Staff - Partner Sales Lead

We need a senior member of GTM staff to own our partner ecosystem which includes global system integrators, consultancies, and technology/ISV alliances, and turn it into a repeatable source of pipeline and closed revenue across our five commercial verticals: Manufacturing, Life Sciences/Med Devices, Financial Services, Technology Media and Telecom, and Insurance. You understand how GSIs and consultancies run their practices, how they build their books of business, and what it takes for them to bring a vendor into their accounts. jobs.title: Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** Our client, an engineering firm specializing in renewable energy, water, and environmental solutions, is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer** to manage projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, and support the design of hydroelectric, fisheries, and water resource infrastructure. This role combines technical design and project leadership responsibilities, including structural analysis of concrete and steel systems, coordination across engineering disciplines, and direct client interaction throughout project execution. The Senior Structural Engineer will oversee multiple projects, ensure quality and consistency in deliverables, and contribute to team development and long\-term client relationships. **This is a full\-time position open to candidates located in Portland, OR; Redmond, WA; Essex, CT; Falmouth, ME; and Pittsfield, ME.** **Pay range: $112,000 \- $170,000 DOE** **Benefits:*** Comprehensive medical/dental/vision package * 401(k) with 4% employer match and 100% immediate vesting * 10 Floating Holidays * Company Paid Short\-Term Disability and Life Insurance * Paid Parental Leave * Tuition Assistance * Employee Ownership **Responsibilities:*** Technical Expertise and Design Leadership: * Perform advanced structural engineering analysis and design, applying standard and advanced engineering principles across complex projects. * Develop and implement improved techniques, procedures, and design solutions that enhance technical capabilities. * Review analyses and designs to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement. * Apply interdisciplinary engineering knowledge, including regulatory and permitting considerations. * Serve as a technical lead on multi\-discipline projects and may act as a Discipline Group Leader. * Project Management and Execution: * Manage or support multiple projects, overseeing scope, schedule, and quality of deliverables. * Coordinate detailed phases of engineering work and ensure alignment across project teams. * Estimate resource needs, assign tasks, and monitor progress to meet deadlines. * Provide leadership on project scope, objectives, budgets, and execution strategies. * Client and Team Collaboration: * Lead client meetings and serve as a representative of the firm. * Build and maintain strong client relationships to support ongoing and future work. * Collaborate with internal teams across disciplines to deliver integrated project solutions. * Mentor and guide junior staff, including reviewing work for QA/QC and supporting development. * Business Development and Ownership: * Support proposal development and contribute to competitive positioning of the firm. * Maintain and grow relationships with existing and prospective clients. * Contribute to internal and external technical knowledge sharing through training, presentations, or publications. **Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program or related field. * Licensed Professional Engineer (PE). * 10\+ years of experience in structural engineering. * Experience with hydroelectric, fisheries, or water resource projects preferred. * Specialized experience within structural engineering such as seismic design or finite element modeling is a plus. * Strong knowledge of engineering principles, standards, and codes applicable to structural engineering (e.g., AISC, IEEE, ASME). * Experience with analysis and design of concrete and steel structures, particularly in and around water environments. * Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams including hydrology/hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and geotechnical engineers. * Proficiency with structural modeling and design software such as MathCAD, RISA\-3D, SAP2000, AutoCAD, and Revit. * Proficiency with CAD software and discipline\-specific engineering tools. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage projects and client relationships. * Experience working with clients and contractors during planning and construction phases. * Familiarity with regulatory and permitting processes is a plus. * Proven experience managing project teams, including junior and senior staff, drafters, and coordinators. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. * Experience serving as a Project Manager and/or Technical Lead on multidisciplinary projects. * Experience preparing proposals and supporting business development efforts. * Ability to build and maintain long\-term client relationships and contribute to ongoing business development. * Passion for mentoring and developing junior staff, including reviewing work for quality and consistency. * Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams across all phases of a project lifecycle. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, and Outlook. * Ability to develop and expand technical specialties within the discipline and contribute to knowledge sharing. * Must possess permanent authorization to work in the United States and be able to acquire authorization to work in Canada. * Must be willing to travel and possess a valid driver’s license. Work sponsorship is not available at this time. Third\-party candidates will not be considered for this position. ACS Professional Staffing will provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to the applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, gender, genetic information, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by federal or state law. The company will provide reasonable accommodations to allow an applicant to participate in the hiring process if so requested. If you have any questions about the job posting, please contact recruiting@acsprostaffing.com If you have any questions about our Reasonable Accommodation Policy, please feel free to email hr@acsprostaffing.com

jobs.title: AI Solutions Support Lead
jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry. At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations. **How does this role contribute to our collective success?** AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical. The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science \& AI Delivery team, ownership of day\-to\-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role. Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science \& AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle. The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders. **What will you do in this role?** Own Production AI Solutions * Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams. * Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence * Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions. * Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements. Lead AI Support \& Incident Management * Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions. * Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams. * Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services. * Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively. * Support post\-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions. Monitor Solution Performance \& Effectiveness * Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization. * Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness. * Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards. * Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities. Drive Continuous Improvement \& Enhancements * Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions. * Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements. * Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities. * Support release planning and production deployments. Collaborate Across Technology \& Data Teams * Work closely with the broader Data Science \& AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support. * Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependen : * High availability and reliability of production AI solutions. * Timely resolution of incidents and defects. * Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support. * Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes. * Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk. * Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities. * Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support. * Well\-managed support teams and partner resources. **About You** You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement. You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes. **Skills \& Experience** Essential * Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data\-driven solutions. * Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement. * Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third\-party delivery partners. * Strong incident management and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions. * Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices. * Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. * Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. * Strong organisational and leadership capabilities. **Desirable** * Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions. * Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies. * Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements. * Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices. **Working Arrangements** This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability. Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out\-of\-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business\-critical operational events. **Role Factors:** In this role, you will typically be required to: Attend your local office at least three (3\) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business. Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture. **What we offer:** For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 \- $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 \- $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes. **This posting is for an existing vacancy.**

jobs.title: Field CTO - Data & Agentic Transformation, Google Cloud
jobs.description: **Who We Are** We're the Accenture Google Business Group Mid\-Market team, a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid\-market, high\-growth, and fast\-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real\-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the mid\-market segment. **The Domain** Data and AI are no longer back\-office functions — they're the engine of every modern business decision. And with the arrival of agentic AI, we're entering a new era: intelligent agents that don't just analyze data but act on it — automating complex workflows, making autonomous decisions, and transforming how companies operate. jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; jobs.title: Data Center Structural Engineer, AMER Design Engineering - East Regional Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Data Center Structural Engineer to join its design team in Herndon, Virginia. AWS designs, builds, and operates Data Centers (DC) around the world and is a leader in worldwide cloud\-computing infrastructure. Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost effective DC facilities. Our team is responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand. As a DC Structural Engineer at AWS, you will be part of the design team for Amazon DCs in our Americas Region and impact other projects around the world. As a Structural Engineer at AWS you will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical DC facilities, provide technical guidance to team members, review milestone drawings by consultants, solve large scale implementation issues, and be responsible for structural design requirements. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. About the team \*Why AWS\* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. \*Diverse Experiences\* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. \*Work/Life Balance\* We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. jobs.title: Tier 2 - IT Support Specialist
jobs.description: **Tier 2 IT Support Specialist** **Home\-Based / Hybrid – 3 Days Remote / 2 Days Onsite in Sunrise, Florida** **About Artemis IT** Artemis IT is a leading Managed Services Provider (MSP) based in Melbourne, Florida. For more than 30 years, we’ve helped organizations throughout Florida leverage technology to improve productivity, security, and business success. Our technical team supports a wide variety of customer environments and technologies, providing an opportunity to continuously learn, solve new challenges, and build a long\-term career in IT. If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy solving problems, take ownership of customer issues, and want to continue developing your skills in Microsoft cloud and modern workplace technologies, we’d love to meet you. **Position Summary** The Tier 2 IT Support Specialist serves as an escalation resource for our Tier 1 Service Desk and support team and plays a key role in delivering exceptional technical support to our managed services customers. This is a **home\-based hybrid position located in South Florida**. The specialist will typically spend **two days per week providing onsite technical support at an assigned Artemis IT customer location in Sunrise, Florida, and three days per week working remotely from home as part of our Tier 2 support and escalation team**. Some additional customer dispatching may be required during traditional remote work from home days. Candidates should live within a reasonable commuting distance of Sunrise and be comfortable traveling to the assigned customer location on scheduled onsite days. Occasional travel to other customer locations may be required based on business needs. The ideal candidate has solid troubleshooting skills across Windows desktop, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and networking, along with exposure to server, cloud, endpoint management, and infrastructure technologies. This role requires someone who can think critically, take ownership of technical issues through resolution, communicate effectively with customers, identify root causes, and recognize opportunities to reduce recurring problems. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT support professional who wants the flexibility of a primarily home\-based position while maintaining direct customer interaction and developing deeper expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, cybersecurity, automation, and Microsoft Modern Workplace technologies. **What You’ll Do** **Tier 2 Support \& Escalation** * Own escalated Tier 2 support issues through resolution, coordinating with senior engineers when additional escalation is required. * Provide remote Tier 2 escalation support to Artemis IT managed services customers during home\-based workdays. * Troubleshoot and resolve Windows desktop, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, server, network, and application issues. * Identify root causes and recurring technical problems and recommend improvements that increase reliability and reduce future support requests. * Provide clear and professional communication to customers throughout the troubleshooting and resolution process. * Collaborate with Tier 1 technicians and other technical team members to resolve issues and share knowledge. * Assist with more advanced technical issues and projects under the guidance of senior administrators and engineers. **Dedicated Onsite Customer Support** * Serve as the assigned onsite technical resource for an Artemis IT managed services customer in **Sunrise, Florida, approximately two days per week**. * Build strong relationships with customer users and leadership while providing responsive, professional technical support. * Proactively identify technology issues and opportunities for improvement while onsite rather than relying solely on incoming support requests. * Troubleshoot workstation, printer, conference room, network, wireless, and other technology issues. * Maintain accurate customer documentation and communicate issues requiring additional resources or follow\-up to the appropriate Artemis team members. **Microsoft 365 \& Modern Workplace** * Perform routine Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting, including user accounts, licensing, groups, permissions, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. * Support Microsoft Entra ID identities, authentication, MFA, and access\-related issues. * Assist with Microsoft Intune device enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, and policy management. * Support Windows 10/11 device configuration, troubleshooting, security, and lifecycle management. * Develop increasing proficiency with Microsoft Modern Workplace technologies through hands\-on experience, training, and certification. **Systems \& Infrastructure Support** * Support Windows Server and Active Directory environments. * Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, VPN, firewall, wireless, and network connectivity issues. * Assist with server, virtualization, backup, and infra  10/11 **Windows Server** Active Directory **Microsoft Defender** Fortinet **Datto RMM** Datto BCDR **Autotask PSA** IT Glue **Hyper\-V** Veeam **PowerShell** You are **not expected to already be an expert in every platform**. We are looking for strong technical fundamentals, troubleshooting ability, customer service, ownership, and the desire to continue learning. **What Success Looks Like** Within your first year, you should be able to: * Independently resolve most Tier 2 support issues within your areas of responsibility. * Provide exceptional onsite technical support and build a strong relationship with your assigned customer in Sunrise. * Work effectively and independently from your home office while remaining connected and collaborative with the Artemis service team. * Effectively troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and common networking issues. * Recognize when an issue requires escalation and effectively collaborate with senior technical resources. * Maintain accurate, useful customer and technical documentation. * Identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements that address the root cause. * Demonstrate increasing proficiency with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, security, and automation. * Share knowledge and help strengthen the capabilities of the overall service team. **Why Join Artemis IT?** At Artemis IT, you’ll work alongside a collaborative team that believes in sharing knowledge, solving problems together, and investing in professional growth. We are committed to helping our technical staff build **careers—not just jobs**. We provide: * **Home\-based work three days per week** * A consistent two\-day\-per\-week onsite customer assignment * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * Paid Time Off and company holidays * Paid Microsoft certification training * Career advancement opportunities * Exposure to a wide variety of technologies and industries * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft 365, and modern cloud technologies * Opportunities to work alongside experienced administrators and engineers * A supportive, team\-oriented environment where ideas and continuous improvement are encouraged **Grow Your Career** The Tier 2 IT Support Specialist is part of Artemis IT’s defined technical career path. As your skills and experience grow, advancement opportunities may include roles such as: * Modern Workplace Systems Administrator * Senior Support Specialist * Systems Engineer * Cloud Engineer As Artemis continues expanding our Microsoft Modern Workplace practice, you’ll have opportunities to develop deeper expertise in cloud identity, endpoint management, automation, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and Microsoft cloud technologies. If you are a strong IT support professional in the South Florida area who enjoys solving problems, working directly with customers, taking ownership of technical issues, and continuously developing your skills, we’d like to hear from you. **Ready to build your career with Artemis IT? Apply today.** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $52,000\.00 \- $62,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of professional IT support experience to you have? * Have you worked in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or multi\-client IT support environment before? * What is your desired annual salary for this role? * Briefly describe your experience with Windows Server environments. * Briefly describe your experience with Windows Desktop and M365 environments. * Briefly describe your experience with Firewalls, Routing, and Network Switching. * Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this role? * Briefly describe your experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Intune. Ability to Commute: * Sunrise, FL (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Sunrise, FL: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sunrise, FL

jobs.title: ITS Leader
jobs.description: Intelligent Transport Systems Americas Region  WAS00007U Requisition \# **Joining Arup** Arup’s purpose, shared values, and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. At Arup, our decisions and actions aim to produce safe, inclusive, and resilient communities, infrastructure, and cities. Arup is an employee\-owned, global engineering and consulting firm. Our integrated, cross\-disciplinary approach brings together planners, engineers, designers, digital specialists, and advisors to meet our clients’ needs. Our West Coast Transportation team is looking for an Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Associate to provide local senior leadership for West Coast ITS projects and pursuits while working as part of the Americas ITS / Intelligent Mobility team. Seattle is the preferred location, with consideration for other West Coast Arup offices (Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego). The role will support a growing ITS business across the Americas, with a focus on West Coast clients, projects, and pursuits. **The Opportunity** The ITS / Intelligent Mobility team supports public agencies, airports, campuses, and infrastructure owners on projects that combine transportation operations, technology, systems engineering, and implementation. Example work includes: * WSDOT TSMO On\-Call and WSDOT Drone Researc * Port Hood / Hood River White Salmon Bridge Replacemen * Stanford University traffic monitoring / LPR proof of concep * CVX Studies / Concept of Operations / Engineering Service * California High Speed Rail technology suppor * TxDOT Future Connected Corrido * NYSDOT TSM * Lower Hudson Transit Link Responsibilities * Support Regional Leader to grow Americas ITS business leading the Westcoast geography. * Lead ITS / Intelligent Mobility assignments from planning and Concept of Operations through design, systems engineering, deployment support, testing, and operations consulting. * Manage task orders and work packages, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, and deliverable quality. * Provide senior technical review for ITS plans, specifications, requirements, cost estimates, Concept of Operations documents, and systems acceptance testing materials. * Support business development, client relationships, capture planning, proposals, and interviews for ITS\-led and ITS\-supported work. * Work across roadway, transport planning, civil, electrical, digital, systems, advisory, and operations teams to integrate ITS into multidisciplinary projects. Mentor junior and mid\-level staff and help build West Coast ITS delivery capacity. * At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. **Is this role right for you?** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, transportation engineering, electrical engineering, communications engineering, systems engineering, planning, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in ITS, traffic operations, transportation technology, intelligent mobility, or related infrastructure work. * Experience leading projects, task orders, or major work packages, including client coordination, scope, fee, schedule, staffing, and quality control. * Experience with public\-sector transportation clients. West Coast DOTs, transit, airport, campus, city, or smart mobility experience is preferred. * Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences. * PE preferred. AICP, PTOE, PMP, RSP, CCNA, systems engineering credentials, or comparable qualifications are also relevant. Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. **What we offer you** At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. **Benefits at Work** \- At Arup, we have a comprehensive and valuable benefits program that works for our employees and their families while keeping costs low. These benefits provide health and welfare security for you as well as paid time off for rest and renewal. As a member of Arup, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance). Our Global Profit Share Plan (paid bi\-annually) provides an opportunity for you to share in the success of the Firm. As a valued employee of Arup, you can also choose to participate in our 401(k) plan with up to 10% company match to help you save for your future **Flexible Working** \- We believe that flexible arrangements create a more inclusive way of working that supports our diversity and the wellbeing of our people. Options for alternative schedules and the ability to work outside of the office for a portion of your workweek are available **San Diego Hiring Range** – Hiring Range \- The good faith base salary hiring range for this job if performed in San Diego is $180,000 to $200,000 per year. **This range is commensurate with experience, educational background, and skill level.** Benefits are not included in the base salary. Please note hiring ranges for candidates performing work outside of San Diego will differ. **Different People, Shared Values** Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. **Our Application Process** We will be reviewing our candidates for this position on a rolling basis. Once you have applied you will be evaluated and potentially moved on to the next round, at which point a member of the talent resourcing team will reach out to you directly. **Arup is an equal opportunity employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of a protected veteran, or disability. **Stay safe online.** Recruitment fraud is on the rise, and Arup’s name, logo, and branding have been used in fraudulent job advertisements. Arup will never ask for bank information as part of our recruitment process. \#LI\-VM1

jobs.description: **Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture\- Where Innovation Meets Comfort** **Who We Are:** At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions\-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains \#1 in our industry. If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business. **If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board. **Summary:** As a Senior Warehouse Automation Process Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming our distribution centers into cutting\-edge Smart Warehouses. You will lead the design and implementation of high\-speed automated equipment, leveraging advanced robotics, PLC programming, and 2D and 3D modeling applications. In this senior role, you will develop custom automated solutions, ensure seamless integration with existing systems, and drive strategic decisions to optimize automation processes. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, offer expert technical guidance, and oversee the entire project lifecycle. Additionally, you will mentor junior engineers, nurturing their professional growth. Your extensive experience will be essential in maintaining our competitive edge and adapting to the evolving demands of the industry. **Responsibilities:** **Strategic Leadership \& Visionary Planning:** * Develop and execute a long\-term strategic roadmap for warehouse automation, aligning it with company goals and competitive market trends. * Lead high\-level strategy sessions with senior leadership to identify key areas for automation investments and innovation. * Identify and implement cutting\-edge robotics and automation technologies that provide a competitive edge while improving operational efficiency. **Advanced System Design \& Integration:** * Lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced automated systems for large\-scale, multi\-site warehouse operations. * Create and oversee detailed engineering plans, process flow diagrams, and system layouts, ensuring they are aligned with strategic and operational objectives. * Lead the integration of automated systems with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), and other enterprise\-level IT systems for cohesive operations. **Risk Mitigation \& Compliance Oversight:** * Conduct thorough and advanced risk assessments, developing comprehensive mitigation strategies and contingency plans for automated systems to ensure operational reliability and safety. * Ensure all automated processes and systems comply with international safety and industry standards, leading regular audits and compliance reviews to enforce adherence and identify areas for improvement. **Complex Project Management:** * Oversee the installation, commissioning, and testing phases of complex, multi\-faceted automation projects, ensuring all milestones are delivered on time and within budget. * Manage large\-scale project timelines, budgets, and resources meticulously, using your senior\-level experience to handle complex, multi\-site implementations. * Coordinate with project managers, executive stakeholders, and global partners, aligning automation projects with broader organizational and strategic goals. **Technical Expertise \& Innovation:** * Provide high\-level technical support and troubleshooting, drawing on your deep and diverse expertise to solve complex automation challenges and streamline operations. * Develop advanced monitoring and analysis frameworks for system performance, making strategic, data\-driven adjustments to optimize efficiency and throughput. * Continually lead evaluations of emerging automation technologies and trends, identifying opportunities to incorporate innovative solutions into our warehouse operations. **Mentorship \& Development:** * Mentor and develop junior engineers and technical staff, fostering their professional growth and ensuring they are equipped with the latest industry knowledge and skills. * Lead collaborative workshops and training sessions for cross\-functional teams and warehouse staff on advanced automation and maintenance techniques. * Establish a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the engineering team. **Strategic Vendor \& Partner Management:** * Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers, vendors, and technology partners globally, negotiating optimal contracts and sourcing the best automation solutions. * Lead high\-level negotiations and led automation, machine vision, and digital twin technologies. * Experience within high\-volume distribution, e\-commerce, retail, or manufacturing operations. * Strategic thinking and leadership * Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills * Excellent verbal and written communication * Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills * Project management and organizational excellence * Continuous improvement mindset * Strong attention to detail * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Customer\-focused approach with a solutions\-oriented mindset * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross\-functional teams * Professionalism, integrity, and accountability **Work Environment:** This position is located in an active industrial manufacturing and distribution center with moderate to high noise levels, temperature variations, and material handling equipment in operation. The role may require extended periods of standing or walking on concrete floors and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses and steel\-toed boots. The fast\-paced environment involves time\-sensitive and safety sensitive operations and may include various shift schedules to support production and distribution needs. **Benefits We Offer:** * Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program * Paid Time Off; increases with years of service * Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings * Professional Development Opportunities * Tuition Assistance * Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific) * 401(k) and Profit Sharing * Life Insurance **Our Core Values:** * **Honesty \& Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights. * **(Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion. * **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work. * **Growth \& Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities. * **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level. * **Customer\-Centric \& Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams. * **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools. Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below: **Corporate Social Responsibility** **View Our Corporate Brochure** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide a drug\-free working environment. While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises. **Notice to Search Firms:** *We are not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. We will not pay any placement, referral or other fees to any search firms unless we have agreed otherwise in a valid, written agreement for the specific position posted and signed by an authorized representative of Ashley Furniture Industries.* * ***Please note this position is not eligible for current or future employment sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or at any time in the future.***

jobs.title: CFD Engineer - AI Simulation Output Review (Remote)
jobs.description: CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) assignments. * Grade cfd engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for CFD Engineer \- AI Simulation Output Review (Remote) work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * CFD Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Technology at Bridgewater** The Technology team at Bridgewater engineers systems to understand the world. These systems synthesize and industrialize our global understanding into a hive mind of macroeconomic knowledge which enables us to educate and collaborate with the world’s most influential central banks and policy makers and carefully and strategically manage the world’s most important capital. Our technologists are engineering highly available, high performing, and highly secure cloud platforms and infrastructure which support and scale our investing operations. **About the Team** The goal of the Portfolio and Trading teams is to translate our understanding of how the global economy works into strategy specific portfolios and execute those investment decisions with maximum precision, efficiency, and reliability. Working alongside the Portfolio team is a uniquely talented technology group that builds and manages the platforms that allow our portfolio strategists, investors, and operations teams to create and test new portfolio strategies and logic, construct portfolios, and manifest our desired portfolios to securities we can trade in the markets. Working alongside our Trading team are technologists who design, build, and maintain the systems that power execution, data flow, and real\-time decision\-making across global markets. They work closely with investors and traders to optimize performance, automate processes, and ensure the firm’s strategies are implemented with speed, accuracy, and resilience. **About the Role** We are hiring a "Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure" into this team, sitting at the intersection of software engineering, testing strategy, and platform architecture, with a strong emphasis on agentic development loops and minimizing latency and downtime in production. You will own the platforms and pipelines that turn our portfolio logic into executed trades, treating infrastructure as a first\-class software problem. You will be equally at home hardening production systems and building the testing environments that let engineers and autonomous agents ship changes quickly and safely, taking end\-to\-end ownership rather than working within a narrow, traditional IT role. Success means faster, more confident delivery for our Portfolio Implementation teams, with production latency and downtime driven toward zero. **You Will Drive the Following Responsibilities** * Own critical infrastructure and application services end\-to\-end, from design through deployment and long\-term operation. * Build and govern the production pipelines that construct, validate, and execute portfolios, engineered for reliability and low latency. * Design the environments and frameworks that let engineers and autonomous agents validate changes rapidly and safely. * Accelerate agentic development loops through automation, tooling, and self\-service platforms. * Instrument systems for observability and continuously drive down latency, failure rates, and mean time to recovery. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of strong computer science fundamentals in technically rigorous environments with a high engineering bar * A track record of applying software engineering rigor to infrastructure, treating cloud\-native development and CI/CD platforms as first\-class software * Ability to own both production pipelines and testing assets that cater to a large, diverse user base ranging from portfolio operators, investment engineers, and other software engineers. * Full\-stack application ownership, from design through long\-term operation (this is not an infrastructure only role) * Experience building highly available, performant, secure systems at scale (ability to deal with complex security architecture is mandatory) * Exposure to, or enthusiasm for, agentic systems and autonomous delivery; excellent communication and a fit for our transparent, meritocratic culture **Location Requirements** The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is two days per week at our Westport, CT campus. **Compensation Band** The compensation range for this role is $350K \- $500K inclusive of base salary, discretionary bonus, and potential long\-term incentive. The expected base salary for this role is between 50\-75% of the range. **Bridgewater Employee Benefits** One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits including: * Health insurance with 100% premium covered and access to additional concierge medical services * 401(k) plan with generous employer match * Paid time off, including fully paid parental leave and a competitive PTO package * Workplace flexibility and access to back up childcare * Financial assistance for family building support, including adoption and egg freezing * Workplace wellness, including on\-site gyms, free meals and healthy snacks, and meditation rooms * An engaged and active community that includes many company events, affinity networks, and extracurricular interest groups Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. **About Bridgewater** Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. **Our Culture** Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision\-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self\-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300\+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re\-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. **Why Choose Bridgewater?** It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential. One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. **Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

packages, and documentation. * Strong programming and development skills in SQL, Spark SQL, and PySpark. * Strong experience with Delta Lake and Databricks data\-engineering capabilities. * Experience metadata\-driven data\-engineering solutions. * Experience implementing data\-quality, validation, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, and observability capabilities. * Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices for dbt and Databricks. * Experience with Git\-based source control and automated deployment processes. * Strong understanding of performance optimization and troubleshooting of large\-scale data pipelines. * Ability to translate architecture standards and business requirements into practical engineering solutions. * Experience conducting technical design and code reviews. * Ability to mentor and provide technical direction to Data Engineers. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills. **Preferred Skills:** * Databricks certification. * dbt certification or significant production implementation experience. * Experience with AWS\-based Databricks environments. * Experience with enterprise data governance, metadata management, lineage, and data\-product concepts. * Experience with Control\-M or other enterprise workload scheduling/orchestration platforms. * Experience working on large\-scale enterprise jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** **10% Equity \| PropTech \+ AI \| Founding Team** **The Opportunity** **We are assembling the founding team behind a new company designed to challenge one of the largest and most established consumer industries in America.** **We aren’t ready to publicly share everything we’re building.** **But we can share the thesis:** **AI is about to dramatically change the economics of selling a home. We intend to be ahead of that change.** **We are building a national real estate platform that combines AI\-powered listing technology, transparent flat\-fee services, and an optional layer of in\-person support into a fundamentally different consumer experience.** **Not another lead\-generation company.** **Not another CRM.** **Not another slightly cheaper version of a traditional brokerage.** **Something different.** **And we’re looking for the Founding CTO who wants to build it with us.** **Why This Is Interesting** **Most startups entering real estate eventually encounter the same problem:** **They can build the technology.** **They can raise money.** **They can generate demand.** **But actually operating a brokerage nationally introduces an enormous regulatory and licensing challenge.** **We have an opportunity to approach the market with licensing capabilities across all 50 states from the beginning.** **That changes what can be built.** **Instead of proving a concept in one state and spending years assembling the infrastructure required to expand, our ambition is national from day one.** **Combine that with experienced leadership, strong sales capabilities, direct industry knowledge and a business model that has already attracted significant interest from venture capital, private industry and strategic players, and we believe the ingredients exist to build something unusually large.** **What We’re Building** **We won’t publish the entire product roadmap here.** **The broader vision is straightforward:** **Flat\-fee real estate \+ AI listing technology \+ optional in\-person services.** **We believe homeowners should be able to use technology to handle significantly more of the home\-selling process themselves while having professional assistance available exactly when they need it.** **That means rethinking the entire experience rather than simply digitizing the traditional one.** **The technology could ultimately touch areas including:** **\* AI\-assisted property listing** **\* Pricing and market intelligence** **\* Listing distribution** **\* Marketing automation** **\* Transaction management** **\* Consumer guidance** **\* Showing coordination** **\* Document workflows** **\* Communications** **\* Brokerage operations** **\* Marketplace/service infrastructure** **\* Local, on\-demand assistance** **Some of what we intend to build is obvious.** **Some of it isn’t.** **The latter is a major reason we’re intentionally keeping this description broad.** **Your Role** **You would join as our Founding Chief Technology Officer and a true equity partner.** **This is not a position where someone else hands you a finished product specification and asks you to manage engineers.** **You will help determine what the product becomes.** **You’ll work directly with the founding team to translate a significant industry opportunity into a technology platform capable of operating nationally.** **Early on, you’ll be a builder.** **You’ll architect.** **You’ll prototype.** **You’ll write code.** **You’ll experiment with AI.** **You’ll decide what we build internally and what we integrate.** **You’ll probably kill some ideas and discover better ones.** **As the company grows, you’ll build the engineering organization around the architecture and technical vision you helped establish.** **The Technical Challenge** **We aren’t looking to sprinkle AI on top of an existing brokerage model and call it innovation.** **The question we’re interested in is much larger:** **If you were designing the process of selling a home today, with modern AI, automation and software available from the beginning, how much of the traditional model would you actually recreate?** **That’s the problem we want our CTO thinking about.** **The platform will require a combination of sophisticated consumer software, AI systems, real estate data, APIs, transaction infrastructure, brokerage operations and automation.** **And there is substantial room for the CTO to influence how those pieces come together.** **Who We’re Looking For** **We’re looking for a technical founder, not simply an employee with a CTO title.** **Someone who can move between architecture and execution.** **Someone who can build the first version and eventually recruit the people capable of building the hundredth.** **Experience with several of the following would be valuable:** **\* Full\-stack application development** **\* AI/LLM systems** **\* Agentic AI and automation** **\* API architecture** **\* Cloud infrastructure** **\* Data\-intensive applications** **\* SaaS platforms** **\* Marketplaces** **\* FinTech or PropTech** **\* Payments** **\* Security and privacy** **\* Real estate/MLS data** **\* Scaling engineering organizations** **Real estate experience is helpful, but not necessary.** **The ability to build quickly, think independently and recognize enormous technical leverage is.** **Why Join Now?** **Because the most interesting time to join a company isn’t after everything is obvious.** **It’s before.** **The founding team brings experience across real estate, brokerage operations, strategy, sales, marketing, product development and company growth.** **We have a significant structural advantage that would be difficult for a new entrant to reproduce quickly.** **We have a defined market thesis.** **We have a clear vision.** **And we are intentionally leaving one major seat at the founding table open:** **Technology.** **The person who fills it won’t inherit the technical strategy.** **They’ll create it.** **Compensation** **This is an equity\-first founding opportunity.** **Founding CTO Equity: 10%** **That’s meaningful ownership because we want meaningful commitment.** **We aren’t looking for someone to spend a few hours each week advising us from the sidelines. We want someone who wants to become one of the people who built the company.** **The equity structure would be formally documented with appropriate founder vesting and protections.** **As funding and/or revenue support it, the position is intended to evolve into a compensated executive role while retaining the CTO’s meaningful ownership position.** **The Bigger Picture** **The residential real estate industry represents an enormous amount of consumer spending.** **Technology has changed almost everything surrounding the transaction.** **Search changed.** **Marketing changed.** **Mortgage technology changed.** **Consumer behavior changed.** **And now AI is changing what consumers can reasonably do for themselves.** **We believe that creates a window for a very different kind of real estate company.** **One that combines technology, national brokerage infrastructure and real\-world services rather than choosing between them.** **We have a very specific vision for what that company can become.** **We’re intentionally not putting all of it in a job posting.** **If you’re the kind of technical founder who sees a massive legacy industry and immediately starts wondering how much of it can be rebuilt, we’d like to show you the rest.** Employment Type Pay: $60\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Expected hours: 1\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote
