jobs.title: Senior Growth Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Growth Engineer — Client Opportunity **Our client, Firecrawl, is hiring a Senior Growth Engineer for a full\-time opportunity in the San Francisco Bay Area, California.** **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area, CA **Hiring:** 1–2 positions **Equity:** Competitive equity; details shared during the interview process About the Opportunity One of our clients, **Firecrawl**, is looking for a **Senior Growth Engineer** to join its engineering team and take ownership of the product experiences that drive developer adoption, activation, and conversion. This is a **full\-stack engineering role focused on Product\-Led Growth (PLG)**. You won't simply be building features and handing them off—you'll own the complete cycle from identifying a growth opportunity and forming a hypothesis to building the solution, running experiments, measuring results, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership and will have direct ownership of measurable growth outcomes. About Firecrawl Firecrawl makes it easy to turn the web into data that AI agents can use. With a single API call, developers can convert any URL into clean, LLM\-ready markdown or structured data—solving a difficult problem that teams building with LLMs repeatedly encounter. Firecrawl reached **8 figures in ARR in its first year** and more than doubled ARR in its second year. Its open\-source project has earned **147K\+ GitHub stars**, and developers, AI agents, and leading AI companies use Firecrawl every day. Firecrawl is a small, high\-ownership team building infrastructure for the next generation of AI applications. The company operates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, building tools that help AI companies and developers gather and work with web data. About the RoleSenior Growth Engineer As a Senior Growth Engineer, you'll build the product experiences that turn developers discovering Firecrawl into active and engaged users. You'll own key parts of the developer journey, including: **Signup → Activation → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion** You'll be expected to understand user behavior, identify friction in the funnel, develop hypotheses, build solutions, run experiments, and use data to determine what works. This role reports to the **VP of Revenue and Success** and offers significant ownership over growth\-focused product initiatives. What You'll DoOwn Growth Surfaces End\-to\-End * Own the signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion experiences. * Identify friction and opportunities across the developer journey. * Build product experiences that improve activation and conversion. * Take ownership from initial hypothesis through production deployment and measurement. Build and Ship Full\-Stack * Build production\-quality experiences across frontend and backend. * Work from the first developer\-facing interaction through the backend systems that power it. * Develop developer\-first product experiences rather than static marketing pages. * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver quickly and reliably. Run Growth Experiments * Design and implement A/B tests and product experiments. * Develop hypotheses based on product data, user behavior, and qualitative feedback. * Define appropriate success metrics before launching experiments. * Analyze experiment results and determine what to scale, change, or discontinue. * Learn from experiments that don't produce the expected results. Own the Metrics * Treat activation, conversion, and other relevant funnel metrics as core engineering outcomes. * Instrument product experiences to measure user behavior. * Monitor funnel performance and identify growth levers. * Use SQL and product analytics to investigate user behavior. * Continuously iterate based on measurable results. Work With Data * Analyze product funnels and event data. * Identify drop\-off points and opportunities for improvement. * Translate data into actionable product hypotheses. * Work closely with product and growth stakeholders to prioritize opportunities. Partner With Leadership * Help shape the growth roadmap. * Work directly with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership. * Bring technical and product perspectives to growth decisions. * Operate independently while keeping stakeholders aligned. Build for Developers * Create experiences that help developers discover, evaluate, integrate, and adopt Firecrawl. * Work with APIs, SDKs, documentation, playgrounds, and other developer\-facing surfaces. * Understand the needs and behaviors of technical users. * Optimize the developer experience throughout the product journey. What We're Looking For We're looking for a **strong full\-stack engineer who combines technical depth with product and growth instincts**. You should be someone who enjoys writing production code while also thinking about: * Why users sign up * Why they activate * Where they drop off * What makes them ado tivation rate * Product adoption * User engagement * Trial conversion * Upgrade conversion * Retention The specific metrics will depend on the initiatives you own. Working Style Firecrawl operates with a high level of urgency and ownership. The environment is fast\-moving, and priorities can evolve quickly as the company scales. The right candidate will be comfortable with: * High ownership * Ambiguous problems * Rapid experimentation * Frequent shipping * Data\-driven decision making * Direct collaboration with leadership * Learning from unsuccessful experiments * Using AI to accelerate development * Taking projects through to measurable outcomes If you enjoy environments where you can **build, measure, learn, and iterate quickly**, this role could be a strong fit. Compensation \& Equity This is a **full\-time opportunity** with competitive compensation and equity. **Equity:** Competitive equity; specific details will be discussed during the interview process. Work Authorization \& Visa Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Firecrawl is open to considering candidates who may require a **visa transfer**, including eligible candidates currently working in the US under statuses such as **H\-1B or OPT**, subject to applicable legal and company requirements. Visa sponsorship or immigration support for candidates who do not currently have US work authorization is **not currently part of the standard hiring process**. Individual circumstances may be reviewed based on business needs and applicable legal requirements. Location **San Francisco Bay Area, California** Candidates should be able to work on\-site in the Bay Area. Candidates who are not currently located in the area should be willing to relocate. Application / Screening To help us evaluate your experience, please be prepared to provide: * **Current location** * **Work authorization status** * **Whether you can work on\-site in the San Francisco Bay Area** * **Whether you would be willing to relocate, if applicable** * **Years of full\-stack engineering experience** * **Experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js** * **Examples of PLG/growth features you personally built** * **Examples of A/B tests or growth experiments you personally ran** * **Metrics or measurable outcomes influenced by your work** * **Experience with product analytics, event tracking, and SQL** * **Experience building LLM\-powered products** * **Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code** Interested? If you're a full\-stack engineer who enjoys **building production software, experimenting with product experiences, working with data, and directly influencing growth**, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply now to explore the Senior Growth Engineer opportunity with our client, Firecrawl.** Pay: $225,000\.00 \- $290,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Application Question(s): * Describe a time you scoped and shipped something without a spec or PM. Are you currently able to work on\-site in the Bay Area? If not, would you be willing to relocate for the role? * What is your salary expectation? * How actively are you exploring new opportunities? * 1\. Tell me about a PLG feature you shipped end to end that measurably moved a metric. Name the feature, the metric, and the before and after. * Have you applied to or interviewed with Firecrawl within the past 6 months, either directly or through a recruitment/consulting firm? If yes, please share when you applied or interviewed and the outcome of the process. Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco Bay Area, CA

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – VEEComm
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission. We’re looking for an engineer who likes getting close to the metal and solving problems that only show up when software meets a real vehicle. In this role, you’ll build safety\-critical software for the telematics control unit, working across embedded C\+\+, vehicle communications, system design, integration, validation, and anomaly resolution. You’ll move between architecture discussions, deep debugging sessions, in\-vehicle investigation, and supplier collaboration to ship software that has to work reliably in the real world, not just in a simulator. **What** **You’ll** **Work On** In this role, you will work on software that lives in one of the most interesting parts of the vehicle stack: where embedded systems, vehicle networking, diagnostics, cloud\-connected services, and cellular/telephony behavior all collide. You won’t just be implementing isolated features. You’ll be tracing problems across system boundaries, debugging issues that reproduce only in real vehicles, balancing reliability and performance in safety\-critical code, and figuring out how hardware, firmware, network behavior, cloud services, and supplier implementations interact when things get weird. If you enjoy deep C\+\+ work, tough root\-cause analysis, and the kind of engineering where you can feel the difference between a clean design and a fragile one, this role gives you a lot to dig into. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead development of technical solutions for current, new, and major upcoming programs, including requirements specification, system decomposition, design, implementation, test strategy, and issue resolution. * Lead software design for the system team and drive software anomaly investigation , root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification. * Perform complex design analysis and make sound engineering tradeoff decisions across functionality, quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and safety. * Develop embedded C\+\+ software on a telematics unit, including safety\-critical components and connected\-vehicle capabilities. * Debug software and system behavior in vehicle , in lab , and across integration environments. * Work directly with suppliers to drive end\-to\-end ticket resolution, technical clarification, validation follow\-through, and closure of field or integration issues. * Provide, communicate, and reinforce common software engineering best practices across the development community. * Act as a subject matter expert for at least one platform area, subsystem, or application component . * Contribute to architecture and design reviews and support system\-level technical direction for the team. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field, with 4 to 6 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge such as a bachelor’s degree in another concentration plus 8 years of full\-time relevant experience. * Strong C\+\+ software development experience in embedded or systems\-level environments. * Experience developing, debugging, and validating software on automotive embedded systems. * Familiarity with CAN and vehicle communication fundamentals. * Familiarity with cloud\-connected system behavior and telephony or cellular communication protocols. * Experience performing design analysis and translating requirements into software architecture, interfaces, and implementation plans. * Experience investigating defects, debugging complex issues, and driving corrective action through closure. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across engineering teams, suppliers, and stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively with moderate autonomy while escalating risk and seeking support appropriately when needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with telematics software, connectivity services, or safety\-critical automotive domains. * Familiarity with embedded Linux environments * Familiarity with automotive diagnostics **Success Profile** **A strong candidate for this role will:** * Write efficient and scalable code. * Build software with quality, maintainability, performance, security, functional safety, efficiency, and deployability in mind. * Shift testing and quality activities as early into development as possible. * Solve moderate problems quickly and creatively, while making intentional engineering tradeoffs. * Investigate issues independently, formulate sound approaches, and execute effectively across feature work and problem solving. * Contribute to components or sections of the system architecture and actively participate in design reviews. * Communicate technical concepts effectively and report workstream status accurately when projects encounter risk. * Recognize when help is needed and pull in the right support to keep delivery moving. * Help onboard and support newer engineers on the team. **Example Scope of Technical Ownership** This engineer may own or become the go\-to contact for one or more of the following areas: * Telematics application software running on the control unit * Connected services behaviors and platform interactions * Vehicle network communication and diagnostics interfaces * Cellular connectivity, packet data, APN, SMS, or modem\-related workflows * Supplier issue triage and end\-to\-end resolution * Integration and validation support for releases, builds, and field debugging \&\#xa;\&\#xa;GM does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1\-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc).\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. Benefits for this role include: * Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience programming in C\+\+, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go. * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. * 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. * Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Join the Cloud AI Data Engineering team! Our team builds the critical data infrastructure, log processing engines, and automated experimentation pipelines that power our executive dashboards and guide product strategy. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design robust, compliant pipelines handling massive datasets and transitioning raw log signals into real\-time metrics. You will directly influence how our customers measure their AI investment and how our engineering teams validate their feature rollouts. The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real\-world impact, aiming to push the state\-of\-the\-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real\-world impact that benefits our customers. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and optimize highly scalable batch and streaming data pipelines to efficiently load enterprise data into Gemini Enterprise, ensuring cost\-efficiency and data freshness. * Develop high\-performance data warehousing solutions, applying best practices in schema design and data modeling to support search, AI models, and analytics. * Implement data governance, quality monitoring, and alerting systems to ensure the ongoing integrity and trustworthiness of the platform's data. * Enforce strict data privacy and security policies, managing access controls and data wipeout procedures for all handled enterprise data. * Partner with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to define requirements and deliver data infrastructure that drives new product capabilities. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, ML Accelerator Fleet Efficiency
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 5 years of experience leading ML design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning). * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. * 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. * Experience with ML development, modeling, optimization, and infrastructure. * Experience with TPUs, TPU system design, and GPUs. * Experience with low\-level programming. * Expertise in ML compilers and runtimes. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. Our team drives machine learning computational efficiency. We manage software to optimize the utilization of hundreds of thousands of Google Accelerator Units globally. We build the software abstraction layer between ML models and physical TPU/GPU hardware. Our mission is to eliminate resource waste across Google’s accelerator fleet, maximizing the physical utility of compute clusters while maintaining peak developer velocity and seamless runtime execution. We strive to provide a cohesive, highly efficient, and transparent runtime environment that enables ML teams to focus entirely on modeling and research rather than physical infrastructure constraints. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive technical strategy, roadmaps, and adoption for large\-scale ML infrastructure development. * Innovate next directions for infrastructure over a 12\-month time horizon given a rapidly changing technology landscape. * Exercise sound engineering judgment to guide sustainable engineering choices for ML systems at scale. * Seek additional opportunities to drive efficiencies in ML workloads using scaling, idle suspend, and improving these capabilities with existing and novel technologies. * Lead a team of \~10 engineers to develop solutions that drive the efficiency of ML workloads. jobs.description: **What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda** Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future\-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.” We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team. If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future! **Job Purpose** --------------- * The Battery Management System Engineer role is responsible for delivering defined engineering assignments with guidance, while expanding the breadth of technical knowledge and starting to deepen expertise in specific technology area. * As a member of the Electrical \& Electronics Architecture (EEA) Division, this position is expected to design vehicles’ electrical and electronics infrastructure, integrate and package the battery related software including input from other systems and divisions. * The position is responsible for Battery Management and Charge Balance system and the correct parameter application among other responsibilities. Role requires heavy correlation with counterparts in Japan side (4MOC) as well as counterparts within the electrical division. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * Project and team management: Breaking down project concept details into required development activities and deciding the overall ECU development plan with Technical Leadership’s guidance and support, correlating technical project details with key stakeholders and negotiating the schedule for deliverables. Informing technical leadership of project status often is expected. * Engineering specification design including electrical circuit hardware and software. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. jobs.title: Manager Transmission Planning
jobs.description: Overview: **About us:** Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Since inception, LS Power has developed or acquired 50,000 MW of power generation, including utility\-scale solar, wind, hydro, battery energy storage, and natural gas\-fired facilities. Through its transmission business, LS Power Grid, the company built and operates 780\+ miles of high\-voltage transmission and 7 transmission utilities and has another 375\+ miles currently in construction or development. LS Power actively invests in and scales businesses that are meeting the growing needs of the energy expansion, including electric vehicle charging, demand response, microgrids, renewable fuels and waste\-to\-energy platforms. Over the years, LS Power has raised more than $89 billion in debt and equity capital to support North American infrastructure. **Our Purpose, Mission, \& Values:** Our Purpose is to solve complex energy problems that improve the world Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership Our People create value and are our Most Valuable asset. We take our values of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork and Taking Ownership seriously and ask candidates to think about how they can help us further enhance our culture with their specific skillsets, capabilities and experiences. **Benefits** We provide our team the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and continue in their career growth. We are committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits that include 100% employer paid premium healthcare, paid parental leave and more. **About the Role:** LS Power is seeking a Manager, Transmission Planning to support and lead transmission planning activities across the company's growing portfolio of transmission development and operating assets. This individual will be responsible for conducting and overseeing complex power system studies, identifying transmission system needs and development opportunities, and providing technical leadership in support of new project development, interconnection activities, and existing utility operations across the United States. This role is based in St. Louis, MO; remote work may be considered for the right candidate. The Manager will serve as a key technical resource within the Transmission Planning team, working closely with internal Development, Engineering, Regulatory, and Operations teams, as well as external utilities, consultants, and ISO/RTO stakeholders. Responsibilities: **What You Will Do*** Lead and perform complex power system modeling and simulations, including load flow, short circuit, transient stability, electromagnetic transient, and production cost studies. * Lead transmission planning studies to identify system needs, constraints, and opportunities for reliability and economic enhancements that support LS Power's transmission development initiatives. * Develop and evaluate transmission solutions and provide technical recommendations to support project development and investment decisions. * Manage, coordinate, review, and interpret interconnection and transmission studies performed by utilities, ISO/RTOs, consultants, and other external parties. * Lead technical activities associated with generation and transmission interconnection processes across applicable ISO/RTO regions. * Provide transmission planning expertise in support of project development, acquisitions, due diligence, and evaluation of transmission system opportunities across NERC regions. * Support transmission asset operations and applicable regulatory and reliability compliance activities. * Partner cross\-functionally with Development, Engineering, Regulatory, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to advance transmission projects and initiatives. * Represent LS Power's interests before ISO/RTOs and on appropriate regional and national committees, working groups, and industry task forces. * Monitor developments in FERC transmission policy, Open Access Transmission Tariffs, NERC reliability requirements, and evolving ISO/RTO transmission planning and interconnection processes. * Manage relationships and coordinate technical work with external consultants and other third\-party stakeholders. * Clearly communicate complex study results, system risks, opportunities, and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and other team members and contribute to the development of transmission planning best practices. Qualifications: **We Want You On Our Team Because You...*** Have demonstrated experience independently performing, reviewing, and interpreting power flow, short circuit, transient stability, and other transmission planning studies. * Have strong working knowledge of transmission planning principles, NERC reliability standards, FERC transmission policy, and ISO/RTO planning and interconnection processes. * Have hands\-on experience with industry planning and modeling tools such as PSS®E, TARA, PowerWorld, GE PSLF, and/or comparable software. * Have experience working within one or more ISO/RTO regions and understand regional transmission planning and interconnection processes. * Have demonstrated ability to lead complex technical assignments and provide sound recommendations based on study results. * Have experience coordinating with utilities, consultants, ISO/RTOs, and other external stakeholders. * Possess strong analytical, problem\-solving, project management, and organizational skills. * Can effectively communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations to a variety of audiences. * Are comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities in a deadline\-driven environment. * Demonstrate the ability to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to other engineers. **Ideally, You Have** --------------------- * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering; an advanced degree in Electrical Engineering with a power systems concentration is preferred. * 6–10 years of direct experience in transmission planning, power system studies, transmission development, or a closely related power systems discipline

jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: The 30\-second version LeadrPro is a B2B marketplace where software sellers meet verified, paid buyers. Our AI agent, LP, now lives inside our customers' Slack workspaces — surfacing matched buyers, drafting outreach, triaging demo requests, and pushing meeting prep into the channels where their teams already work. Every customer's Slack agent is only as good as the prompts behind it. Right now, a human has to sit with each account, learn their ICP, their voice, and their sales motion, and tune the agent until it earns its place in the channel. **That human is you.** You'll be embedded with real revenue teams, writing and testing the prompts that make their agents useful — then turning what works into templates so the next 100 customers get it in an hour instead of a week. This is not a research role. You will talk to customers. You will ship on day three. What you'll actually do **Onboard customer agents.** Run configuration sessions with new accounts, extract their ICP, tone, product positioning, and edge cases, and translate all of it into working system prompts and tool configurations for their Slack agent. **Write, break, and fix prompts.** Draft prompts, build small eval sets from real customer scenarios, run them, find where the agent hallucinates, over\-hedges, or sounds like a robot, and fix it. Version everything. Document why each change worked. **Own the feedback loop.** Read agent transcripts. Find the recurring failure modes across accounts. Bring the top three to the product team every Friday with a proposed fix, not just a complaint. **Turn one\-offs into product.** The job is to make yourself unnecessary. Every bespoke prompt you write should end up as a reusable template, a variable, or an onboarding question. We measure you on how much of your work stops being manual. **Be the customer's person.** When an account says "the agent isn't getting it," you're the one who responds, diagnoses, and closes the loop — usually the same day. What good looks like **Day 30** — You've onboarded 5\+ customer agents end to end without a hand on your shoulder. You've built our first shared eval set. **Day 60** — Median time\-to\-first\-value for a new Slack agent is under 24 hours, down from where we started. You've published a prompt library the rest of the team uses. **Day 90** — At least 60% of new agent configurations are handled by templates you built, not by a person. You've shipped at least one prompt change that measurably lifted a customer metric — reply rate, meetings booked, or agent messages actually acted on. Who this is for * You've built something real with an LLM API — a side project, a tool, an automation. Not a certificate. A thing that ran. * You write clearly. Prompt engineering is 80% writing, and vague writers produce vague agents. * You can read and edit JSON, understand what a tool call is, and debug why one failed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can't be afraid of a terminal. * You're comfortable on a Zoom with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of AI and short on time. * You're allergic to leaving a problem half\-diagnosed. Who this isn't for * Anyone who wants to "explore AI strategy." We need output, not frameworks. * Anyone who needs a spec before starting. You'll get a customer, a goal, and a deadline. * Anyone who would rather not talk to customers. Half this job is listening. Bonus points Experience with Slack's API or bot framework · evals or LLM observability tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, or homegrown) · B2B SaaS or sales ops background · you've worked a quota\-carrying or SDR seat and know why sellers ignore tools Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks jobs.title: Senior .Net Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview:** As a .NET Engineer you will drive the technical modernization of a large\-scale system from .NET Framework 4\.8 to .NET 10\. comfortable with container\-wired test setups. * Experience with AWS ECS / Fargate and ECR for deploying containerized .NET applications. * Familiarity with MassTransit and RabbitMQ or Amazon MQ for event\-driven messaging. * Experience with Hangfire or similar background job processing frameworks. * Proficient in Git and familiar with Agile/SCRUM team processes. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** * Experience building CI/CD pipelines for .NET projects. * Familiarity with micro\-frontend architecture and Angular\-based single\-page applications. * Experience with automated code coverage tooling and enforcing coverage thresholds in CI. * Experience with performance optimization and scalable enterprise backend systems. **We offer\*:** * Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible * A competitive salary and good compensation package * Personalized career growth * Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more) * Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing * Education reimbursement * Memorable anniversary presents * Corporate events and team buildings * Other location\-specific benefits * not applicable for freelancers

jobs.title: MEP Superintendent
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION **Job Title:** Senior MEP Superintendent **Alternate Titles:** MEP Project Engineer; Senior MEP Field Engineer **Reports To:** Site Superintendent / Senior Project Manager **Classification:** Full\-Time Position Summary Norfolk Design \& Construction, LLC is seeking a Senior MEP Superintendent to run daily field coordination of MEP/FP subcontractors while leading pre\-shutdown documentation, equipment disposition, and long\-duration shutdown planning for existing mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems ahead of building renovation. This is a hands\-on field leadership role: managing MEP subcontractors through daily tasks, problem\-solving, schedules, and sequencing; working closely with the owner’s MEP/FP facilities and commissioning staff; and driving the trade coordination that keeps the schedule on track. The role also owns the full existing\-systems lifecycle, from existing\-conditions survey through shutdown, controls transition, and eventual restart/commissioning. The ideal candidate is first and foremost a strong field superintendent with subcontractor management experience, who also brings systems/commissioning fluency to the shutdown and controls\-transition scope. Key ResponsibilitiesDaily Field Coordination \& Subcontractor Management * Manage MEP subcontractors' daily tasks, problem\-solving, schedules, and sequencing on site. * Take an active role in MEP coordination meetings and processes, including with Owner MEP/FP facilities and commissioning staff. * Conduct daily site walks and check in with the MEP foreman. * Assist with daily MEP/FP trade activities and input to the Procore Daily Log. * Assist with planning future work and look\-ahead schedules; work with the Columbia/Norfolk field team. * Support Hoylu work planning and look\-aheads. * Participate in the Daily Huddle with foreman. Pre\-Shutdown Documentation \& Equipment Disposition * Document existing conditions in all basement and penthouse mechanical rooms prior to building shutdown. * Build and maintain a room\-by\-room spreadsheet listing all existing equipment. * Label all equipment in every room with a unique equipment ID. * Indicate equipment disposition for each item: demo, existing to remain, or refurbish. * Document existing equipment operating status prior to shutdown (on/operating, off, leaking, corrosion, etc.). * Capture photos, videos, and Procore Observations for every documented item and condition. Shutdown Planning \& Execution * Assist in the shutdown of existing building equipment and systems. * Assess potential impacts of long\-duration shutdowns (steam, domestic water, water heaters, and similar systems sitting idle for a year or more). * Recommend immediate steps to protect systems during extended idle periods (draining, compressed air blow\-down, winterization, etc.). * Develop a formal Shutdown Plan, parallel in structure and rigor to a Start\-Up Plan. * Determine existing conditions status and assess the impact of the shutdown on equipment and systems' ability to restart the following year. Controls (ATC/DDC) \& Scope Coordination * Verify current status of existing building automation/temperature controls (ATC) systems. * Track demolition, removal/reinstallation, and integration of existing controls with new DDC systems. * Evaluate contract/construction documents against Schneider's scope of work to identify gaps requiring resolution. * Maintain the Annese fire alarm log. * Assist in developing a temporary heat plan for winter conditions. Submittals, QA/QC, Commissioning \& Closeout * Review MEP/FP submittals and RFIs; provide input and drive resolutions. * Perform MEP QA/QC and inspections. * Support system start\-up and commissioning. * Manage the MEP/FP punchlist through closeout. Qualifications * 10–15\+ years of MEP field/superintendent experience, including renovation/gut\-rehab projects with occupied or phased building shutdowns. * Proven track record managing MEP subcontractors directly — daily task direction, problem\-solving, schedule and sequencing ownership. * Strong daily field presence: comfortable running site walks, foreman check\-ins, and daily huddles, and coordinating with institutional facilities/commissioning staff (e.g., Owner MEP/FP facilities). * Experience with Procore and Hoylu (or comparable field management/scheduling platforms). * Experience reviewing MEP/FP submittals and RFIs, and driving resolutions to closure. * Direct experience decommissioning or mothballing existing building systems (steam, domestic water, hydronic, compressed air) for extended idle periods. * Working knowledge of BAS/DDC controls transitions, including demolition and integration of legacy pneumatic or analog controls with new DDC systems. * Ability to read and reconcile construction documents against a controls subcontractor's scope of work to identify and resolve gaps. * Strong documentation discipline: comfortable owning large equipment inventories, ID tagging systems, and photo/video/Procore Observation logging at scale. * Commissioning agent experience or certification (CxA, CCP, or equivalent) a plus, but not required — field leadership and subcontractor management are the priority. **Applicants should email their resume to office@us\-norfolk.com with the subject “Senior MEP Superintendent”** Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer **Early\-Stage Education Technology Startup** **Compensation:** Primarily Equity\-Based **Position:** Co\-Founder / Founding Technical Lead **Schedule:** Flexible **Location:** Remote / Hybrid/ Columbus, OH (preferred but will hire best candidate) About the Company We are an early\-stage education technology startup building a new platform designed to help students explore careers, understand professional pathways, and make more informed decisions about their futures. The product combines interactive digital experiences, artificial intelligence, career exploration tools, simulations, personalized recommendations, and student\-focused content into a single platform. We are now looking for a highly motivated **Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer** who can help take ownership of the technology, strengthen the existing product, and build the technical foundation for future growth. This is not a traditional salaried software engineering position. It is intended for someone interested in joining an early\-stage company as a technical founder and building meaningful ownership through equity. What You'll Do You will work directly with the founder to help shape both the product and technical direction of the company. Key responsibilities may include: * Review, improve, maintain, and expand the existing application and codebase. * Lead development of new platform features from concept through deployment. * Build and integrate AI\-powered features using large language models (LLMs) and third\-party APIs. * Develop scalable backend systems, APIs, databases, authentication, and application infrastructure. * Improve frontend functionality, responsiveness, performance, and user experience. * Develop interactive experiences, simulations, dashboards, and student\-facing tools. * Help establish the company's long\-term technical architecture and development standards. * Troubleshoot bugs, security issues, performance problems, and production issues. * Translate creative product concepts into functional prototypes and production\-ready features. * Help determine what should be built internally versus through external APIs, models, or infrastructure. * As the company grows, potentially help recruit and lead future engineering and product team members. Technical Skills We're Looking For You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. We care most about strong engineering fundamentals, versatility, creativity, and the ability to learn quickly. Experience with several of the following is preferred: **Programming \& Development** * Python * JavaScript and/or TypeScript * React or similar modern frontend frameworks * Node.js and modern web application development * Java * C\+\+ * HTML/CSS * REST APIs and third\-party API integrations * SQL and/or modern database technologies * Git and version control **AI \& LLM Development** * Experience integrating large language models into applications * OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar AI APIs * Prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs * AI agents, tool/function calling, or workflow automation * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or vector databases * Designing AI systems with appropriate reliability, privacy, cost, and safety considerations **Platform \& Infrastructure** * Replit or similar cloud development environments * Cloud deployment and hosting * Authentication and user\-management systems * Database architecture * API development * Application security * Performance optimization * SaaS architecture Experience building educational technology, gamified applications, interactive simulations, 3D/web experiences, or AI\-powered consumer products would be particularly valuable. Creative Product \& Design This role goes beyond writing code. We are looking for someone who enjoys asking, **"How could we make this experience better?"** You should be comfortable contributing ideas around: * UI/UX * Product design * Gamification * Interactive experiences * Student engagement * AI experiences * Visual storytelling * Prototyping * Creative feature development Experience with Figma, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, game development, 3D environments, or similar creative technologies is a plus, but not required. Who We're Looking For The ideal person is entrepreneurial and wants meaningful ownership rather than simply another engineering assignment. You may be a strong fit if you: * Want to help build a company from an early stage. * Enjoy moving quickly and solving ambiguous problems. * Can independently turn ideas into working products. * Are comfortable working with an evolving codebase. * Think about users and business outcomes in addition to engineering. * Have strong product instincts and creative problem\-solving skills. * Are excited about AI, education, career exploration, and emerging technology. * Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical collaborators. * Want the opportunity to influence the company's technology, product, and long\-term direction. Startup experience is valuable but not required. Compensation \& Ownership This is an **early\-stage co\-founder opportunity in which equity is expected to be the primary form of compensation initially**. The specific ownership structure, responsibilities, vesting schedule, time commitment, and future compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates and documented through appropriate agreements. Candidates should understand that early\-stage startups involve significant uncertainty and risk. Equity does not guarantee future compensation or company value. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. model calm judgment when the stakes are high. * Be a champion for our mission in the field: every deployment is an opportunity to demonstrate it. **Requirements** ---------------- **You Might Thrive in This Role If You** * Bring 5\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role as a Forward Deployed Engineer, a Software Engineer with consulting exposure, or a founder with hands\-on deployment experience. * Experience building or consuming MCP servers or agent frameworks. * Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast\-moving or ambiguous environments you know how to sequence work and protect delivery without slowing everything down. * Write and review production\-quality code in Python, TypeScript or comparable stacks; You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse\-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least\-understood problems in the Android ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities:** 1\. Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform\-level functionality 2\. Debug and reverse\-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability 3\. Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases 4\. Diagnose and fix bugs in system\_server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and SurfaceFlinger 5\. Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6\. Resolve and provide technical direction and root\-cause analysis for unknown or hard\-to\-reproduce issues 6\. Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS **Primary Skills Required**: Kotlin, C\+\+ and Java **Experience Required:** 1\. 3\+ years of hands\-on Android platform/framework development experience. 2\. Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long\-running/foreground service) that expose feature\-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications. 3\. Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low\-level Android stability issues. 4\. Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code 5\. Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers) **Additional Experience Preferred**: 1\. Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service. 2\. Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration. 3\. Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks. 4\. Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems. 5\. Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis). 6\. Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture. 7\. Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring\-up **Additional Context for Suppliers:** 1\. This role requires a deep\-dive, problem\-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high\-impact issues. 2\. The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction to other engineers. 3\. Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given our focus on system\_server, car service and platform stability. jobs.title: Design Engineer

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description: Job description: The Product Manager role is pivotal in orchestrating product development, overseeing delivery teams (referred to as pods), and establishing and refining a repeatable and agile delivery methodology. This role involves leading and directing the daily operations of these teams, ensuring their performance aligns with established benchmarks, and cultivating an agile culture conducive to efficient product delivery. This role’s primary purpose is to spearhead product development efforts, leveraging organized delivery teams (pods) and maintaining a dynamic, repeatable agile delivery methodology. It entails not only leading the day\-to\-day activities of these teams but also monitoring and reporting their performance to ensure alignment with objectives. Moreover, fostering an agile delivery culture is paramount to this role’s responsibilities because it promotes an environment where innovation, collaboration, and adaptability drive successful product delivery within the organization. **Responsibilities** * · Partner with functional department leaders to identify high\-value innovation opportunities across Firm operations. * Lead intake, assessment and design thinking sessions that reframe problems and surface the right solution \- not just the requested one. * · Build and maintain a prioritized opportunity pipeline; communicate tradeoffs and sequencing leadership. * · Run rapid prototyping and proofs of concept to validate value before committing to full delivery. * · Define and maintain product vision and roadmap for assigned initiatives, anchored to business process, user workflows and Firm strategy. * · Match the right capability to each problem across a broad toolkit — AI and GenAI, workflow automation, integrations, data products, low\-code, custom build, packaged software configuration. * · Make build, buy or partner decisions across a fast\-moving vendor landscape, lead vendor evaluations against clearly defined success criteria. * · Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, adoption and ongoing iteration. * · Lead a cross\-functional pod of engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, designers and QA through the full SDLC using Agile methodologies. * · Translate business requirements into clear product specifications across solution types \-application features, AI behaviors, automation flows, data products and integrations. * · For AI\-based solutions, define evaluation criteria covering accuracy, reliability, bias, hallucination rates and user\-perceived quality. * · Generate test plans and partner with QA and subject matter experts to validate solutions across representative scenarios prior to release. * · Own release planning and validation across multiple environments; own go/no\-go decisions. * · Partner with Information Governance, Security, Risk and the Firm's Responsible AI and to ensure each product meets data handling, confidentiality, privacy and responsible technology standards. * · Document design choices, data flows, evaluation results and known limitations as part of every release. * · Escalate risk and policy questions promptly; do not ship capability that has not cleared governance review. * Partner with functional departments to redesign business processes alongside technology delivery \- recognizing that automating a broken process delivers little value. * · Plan and execute adoption strategies for staff audiences \- communications, training, enablement, champion networks. * · Define and report on product KPIs covering adoption, time saved, process efficiency, quality, satisfaction and business outcomes. * · Use adoption and outcome data to drive iteration and inform roadmap decisions. Required: * · 10 or more years of IT product management experience across a mix of solution types\- application development, automation, data products, integrations and AI or machine learning. * · Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional Agile pods through the full SDLC. * · Working knowledge of GenAI patterns including RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks and the practical limits of current LLM capability. * · Experience defining product KPIs and reporting on adoption and business outcomes. * · Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership and translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences. Pay: $65\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Your current location * Agile experience in years Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60654

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer, Revenue Operations** -------------------------------------------- **About Stream** ---------------- Stream powers real\-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for billions of end\-users across thousands of apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low\-latency services and a great developer experience. **The role** ------------ The data platform in this role is what our go\-to\-market and product decisions run on. You'll own the pipelines, integrations, and central repository that bring Stream's data together, plus the models that turn it into something the business can trust. We're mid\-migration to GCP, so there's real architecture to shape. Two things make this different from most data jobs. A Revenue Operations team owns the stakeholder relationships and the business questions, so your time goes into building durable systems instead of chasing requirements. And analytics translation is increasingly handled by AI, which is exactly why the engineering underneath it has to be right. Data modeling is the core of this role. It's a small team and a fast, unfinished environment. High drive, sometimes hectic. If you like owning a platform end to end, that's the appeal. **This is a full\-time job opening based in Boulder (3 days hybrid).** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and evolve the ingestion platform.** Python/dltHub pipelines loading into BigQuery, integrating Salesforce, Stripe, Postgres, PostHog, cloud billing, and other GTM systems. Design incremental loading, write dispositions, and scheduling, and make onboarding a new source predictable and low\-risk. * **Build the transformation layer.** SQLMesh models across our layered architecture, clean and well\-tested dimensional models, and clear conventions for grain, naming, and audit. Keep the core business models accurate: revenue waterfall, GTM funnel, marketing attribution, and product usage. * **Improve reliability.** Expand data quality and observability, build freshness checks, reconciliation tests, and execution monitoring. Take point when data is stale, wrong, or late, and trace issues across pipelines, transformations, and upstream systems. * **Own the platform infrastructure.** BigQuery and supporting GCP, plus Terraform, IAM, service accounts, scheduled jobs, and deployment workflows, tuned for security, reliability, and cost. * **Enable the business.** Deliver trusted datasets to Looker Studio, Google Sheets, and our internal CRM, and run reverse ETL back into operational systems like Salesforce. * **Raise the technical bar.** Help shape engineering standards and architecture, review pipeline and model changes, and share context with the analysts and engineers who contribute to the platform. **About you** ------------- You like owning a platform end to end and staying hands\-on while you do it. You're comfortable in a small team, and you're energized by building rather than by growing an org around you. You influence through the work: architecture, code review, and clear conventions, not a title. **You have:** * 5\+ years building and operating production data platforms * Expert SQL and strong Python * Experience designing incremental, idempotent, well\-tested pipelines * Solid experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse * Experience with modern ELT tooling such as SQLMesh, dbt, dltHub, Fivetran, or Airbyte * Experience with orchestration and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Airflow, or equivalent) * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform or a close equivalent * Strong data modeling skills: dimensional modeling, warehouse design, testing, and observability **Bonus points:** * Revenue Operations or GTM data experience * Salesforce and Stripe data modeling * Product analytics platforms such as PostHog * Marketing attribution and funnel analytics * MRR, expansion, contraction, churn, and revenue reconciliation logic * Working closely with business stakeholders while keeping engineering discipline * GCP depth, including IAM, service accounts, and BigQuery cost optimization ### **Why this one is worth a look** * You own the data platform the whole company runs on, not one pipeline or one domain. * Your work powers forecasting, commissions, pricing, churn analysis, product insight, and board reporting. The quality of your engineering shows up directly in how the company runs. * The stack is modern and AI\-forward: Python, dlt, SQLMesh, BigQuery, Terraform, GitHub Actions, with Claude, Cursor, and Linear across the team. * You inherit a foundation that already works, built from scratch, so you evolve and harden it rather than start from zero. ### **You'll thrive here if** * You want a broad, ambiguous platform to own and the autonomy to make calls on it * You ship fast and learn fast, even when things are unfinished * You're comfortable working with teammates across time zones **You probably won't if** you want tightly scoped tickets, a fully defined process before acting, or a slow and highly predictable environment. **Why join Stream?** -------------------- We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (co\-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co\-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. **What we offer** ----------------- * 19\+ days of paid time off plus 10 paid holidays * Hybrid work flexibility (3 days a week from the office) * Free health insurance for the employee and partial coverage for dependents (80% contribution coverage for health and 100% for dental and vision) * 401k contribution plan with 4% match * Fitness stipend * Company equity * Dog\-friendly office! * A Macbook Pro provided * A Learning and Development budget * Team lunches and plenty of snacks * RTD pass \+ free parking pass on Pearl Street * An office on Pearl Street in downtown Boulder * 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary parents * The opportunity to attend or present to global conferences and meetups * The possibility to visit our office in Amsterdam *Note: this list of benefits applies to Colorado\-based employees and is adjusted per your location of residence.* Salary (for Colorado only): Our salary ranges are based on national averages. We have wide ranges so we can be flexible and determine compensation based on a number of factors including the candidate's *skills, level of experience, and location.* *For Colorado\-based candidates we offer a salary $150,000 to $180,000 per year, plus stock options. Final offer within this range depends on experience and interview outcome.* ***Hybrid office policy:*** *applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.* ***Equal opportunity employer statement:*** *Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.* ***Note for external recruiters:*** *We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Deputy Public Works Director
jobs.description: Performs professional engineering work of an administrative, supervisory and technical nature within the Department of Public Works including design, layout, construction management and mapping of municipal projects. Provides technical assistance to other departments, boards and committees as requested. The nature of the work performed requires the employee to establish and maintain effective working relationships with other employees, the Council, committees, outside contractors and consultants and the public. Participates in the planning and implementation of the Town’s Capital Improvement Program. Performs as the department head in the absence of the Public Works Director. Examples of Duties: * Meets with and plans major capital projects with the Public Works Director. Assists the Director in setting project priorities. Plans work priorities and technical aspects of carrying out major capital projects with the Director and Department Supervisors. * Works with NHDES, NHDOT on project related activities and compliance with Federal and State regulations and procedures. * Works with the Director to prepare the annual budget for all of the divisions, analyzing costs of previous years and anticipating future manpower and equipment costs. * Oversees through subordinates technical aspects of work projects and as needed inspects work on\-site. * Oversees all infrastructure maintenance, repair and Public Works construction including streets, sidewalks, sewers, bridges, buildings, traffic signals, traffic signage and special projects as requested. * Communicates and coordinates regularly with appropriate others to maximize the effectiveness and efficiency of interdepartmental operations and activities. * Conducts studies and investigations of Department operations and citizen complaints. * Participates in the preparation of the Department’s Capital Improvement Plan. * Performs special projects for the Public Works Director as requested. * Sets schedules and target dates for all infrastructure projects. * Reviews plans for site developments to the extent that they impact the Town’s infrastructure and regulatory permits; provides technical assistance to Community Development Department and Planning Board * Responds to emergencies such as weather related crisis or system malfunctions. * Prepares for and participates in public presentations for the Council, and Town Meeting, etc. * Supervises all GIS improvements and adjustments to the town wide system. * Represents the Department on and provides technical advice to the Highway Safety Committee and other committees as assigned. * Educates and provides public outreach and response to inquiries from citizens, community and elected officials and other governmental agencies; responds to and resolves difficult and sensitive inquiries and complaints; investigates potential environmental issues and other customer complaints; recommends and implements corrective action. * Works in conjunction with the DPW Director on the EPA Stormwater Permit (MS\-4\) and related required activities; prepares meetings plans, permits and reports for MS\-4 * Represents the Town on the Regional Stormwater Coalition; participates in a variety of advisory and technical committees; attends and participates in meetings of professional organizations. * Responsible for identifying auditing priorities and delegating auditing responsibilities. Generates reports and communicates the findings to senior management, then coordinates corrective/preventative action planning. * Represents the department with regard to permitting and issues concerning water, wastewater, MS\-4 stormwater, industrial pretreatment, cross\-connection control programs, Sanitary Sewer Management Program elements, and any other water/air/wastewater quality initiatives implemented by the department. * Performs other related duties as assigned by the Director. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: A candidate for this position should have a strong knowledge of design, construction and maintenance related to municipal infrastructure, including buildings, roads, sidewalk, storm water systems, bridges, cemeteries, and athletic fields; and be familiar with operations of municipal wastewater collections and treatment systems. Thorough knowledge of the methods, tools, equipment, and materials used in construction, maintenance and repair of municipal infrastructure; knowledge of engineering principles as related to street and highway construction, knowledge of highway construction and maintenance equipment; ability to plan, schedule and coordinate large scale work programs; ability to read and interpret engineering plans and specifications; estimate and plan jobs, and prepare reports, maintain records; knowledge of town, state, federal street construction requirements; ability to plan, coordinate and supervise the work of others; ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, the public and other departments. Minimum Qualifications: Graduation from an accredited college or university with major study in Civil Engineering plus at least ten years of progressively responsible experience in public works engineering, street or highway construction and maintenance work, management or related fields, and including at least five years experience in a supervisory capacity; any equivalent combination of education and experience which demonstrates possession of the required knowledge, skills and abilities. **N.H. Professional Engineer license required**. A valid motor vehicle operator’s license is required. Responsibilities * Assist in planning, coordinating, and supervising public works projects from conception through completion, ensuring adherence to schedules and budgets. * Oversee construction management activities, including construction inspection, quality control, and safety compliance across various civil infrastructure projects. * Manage project scheduling using tools like MS Project or Primavera to ensure timely delivery of engineering initiatives. * Utilize CAD software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, MicroStation, and drafting tools for design engineering, schematics development, and technical report generation. * Conduct hydrological modeling and hydraulic analysis using SWMM, HEC\-RAS, Hydrologic analysis tools, and GIS platforms like ArcGIS and GIS\-based permitting phases. * Collaborate with clients and internal teams to communicate project progress, technical details, and permit requirements effectively. * Lead team members in managing multiple projects involving stormwater systems, water/wastewater treatment facilities, land surveying, geotechnical engineering, and system design. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field; master’s degree preferred. * Proven experience managing civil infrastructure projects with a strong background in construction management and inspection. * Proficiency with CAD software (AutoCAD Civil 3D), Revit, MicroStation, Mathcad, HEC\-HMS/HEC\-RAS, ArcGIS, SWMM, Hydrologic modeling tools, and other technical engineering applications. * Demonstrated ability to lead teams effectively while managing multiple projects simultaneously. * Strong knowledge of stormwater management systems, hydraulics, geotechnical considerations, water/wastewater treatment processes, and system design principles. * Excellent communication skills for client interaction and interdepartmental coordination. * Experience with project scheduling software such as Primavera or MS Project is highly desirable. * Valid engineering license or the ability to obtain one is preferred but not mandatory. Join us in shaping the future of Merrimack’s infrastructure! Bring your technical expertise and leadership skills to a community that values innovation and dedication to public service. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact while advancing your career in a supportive environment committed to excellence in civil engineering and public works management.
